paper.title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
paper.central_claim: Adaptive local goals with explicit completion verification align long-horizon VLN progress; progress-aware memory reduces context overhead while retaining navigation-relevant unresolved state, with competitive zero-shot simulation and real navigation.

provenance.notes: anchors_version=v2 (3ececdd11cc3d144). Session/receipt unavailable. Additional expectation source hashes embedded per entry. Domain hash binds taxonomy. No online search/code execution; all outcomes author_report.

sections_read: Appendix A-F, Algorithm 1, equations 1-15, prompt templates, all tables and figure captions

evidence.quote: The goal g_{k} specifies a desired navigation outcome, while q_{k} identifies the visual evidence or spatial relation that would support its completion.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit paired goal/completion question drives multi-step actor.

evidence.quote: The Verify Agent produces qualitative feedback p_{t+1} that answers q_{k} , identifies supporting observational evidence, and reports unmet or uncertain conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: Model-based qualitative verification, not independent environment truth.

evidence.quote: After compression, the updated memory replaces the detailed completed segment in the shared context.
evidence.support_explanation: Persisted memory within episode; active unresolved state stays separate.

evidence.quote: This framework-level comparison does not isolate goal generation from verification.
evidence.support_explanation: Bundle comparison does not establish separate goal/verifier effects.
Fixed-backbone R2R baseline for framework effect.
Memory compresses at performance cost on stronger model.

evidence.quote: GPT-6-Astra saves 5.52% and 4.05%, with SR decreases of 2 and 1.5 points and an RxR-CE SPL decline from 64.7 to 58.3
evidence.support_explanation: Central efficiency tradeoff not uniformly beneficial.

evidence.quote: Each route is tested three times (24 trials).
evidence.support_explanation: Physical denominator and repeats are stated but route-level results/success criteria not given.

evidence.quote: Verification feedback supports the stop decision, but the inspected action interface does not impose an additional mechanical verification gate on STOP.
evidence.support_explanation: Do not describe semantic verifier as hard external STOP gate.

evidence.quote: We use the benchmark evaluators to compute navigation metrics.
evidence.support_explanation: Simulation endpoints independently scored; internal verifier not audited against labels.

evidence.quote: Efficiency averages include successful and failed episodes with complete usage records and exclude incomplete records.
evidence.support_explanation: Measured token cost includes failures but completeness bias not quantified.

evidence.quote: Goal and verification annotations are scene-aligned explanatory reconstructions, rather than verbatim logged outputs
evidence.support_explanation: Visual cases do not independently verify causal mechanism.

evidence.support_explanation: No evaluator privilege channel during navigation.

evidence.quote: We evaluate 100 episodes each on R2R-CE and RxR-CE
evidence.support_explanation: Simulation cohort denominator; repeat counts not stated.

signatures.information: Instruction, current RGB, requested/executed primitive history, qualitative verifier feedback; no evaluator goal distance or path.
signatures.operation: Goal agent pairs local goal with completion question; actor executes primitive batches; separate verifier observes outcome and recommends continue/revise/advance.
signatures.conditions: Visual completion evidence must be reliable; low-level motion/safety and camera coverage constrain action.
signatures.feedback: Returned observation/execution record, not evaluator label.
signatures.selection_rule: Qualitative completion/revision routing; STOP can bypass mechanical verification gate.
signatures.persistence: Active goal/feedback and history within episode; no learned retained updates.
signatures.later_use: Subsequent steps and goals use observed progress.
signatures.claimed_effect: Off framework raises same-backbone SR over Codex CLI.
signatures.failure_boundary: Uncalibrated verifier, wrong stop, out-of-view hazards.

signatures.information: Completed segment plus earlier memory, instruction, verified keyframes; recent unresolved evidence remains.
signatures.operation: At verified completion compress completed stage into summaries/verification outcomes/keyframe, replace detailed segment, retain active unresolved state.
signatures.conditions: Verification accuracy and summary fidelity; no hard constant-length bound stated.
signatures.feedback: Completion triggers replacement, revision alone does not erase history.
signatures.selection_rule: Completion-driven boundary, no held-out acceptance of candidate memory strategies during runtime.
signatures.selection_data: Within-episode traces; no cross-episode memory mining.
signatures.persistence: m memory and recent r; cleared/compressed only by stated transition.
signatures.later_use: All later goal/actor/verifier decisions use updated shared context.
signatures.claimed_effect: Lower token/context use, subject to SR/SPL penalties.
signatures.failure_boundary: Wrong progress summary can propagate; strongest backbone savings small.

gap.author_gap: Plausible local actions can drift from instruction; accumulated history is expensive and naive truncation loses unresolved route state.
gap.checked_gap: Matched workflow and memory comparisons expose real cost/performance tradeoff, not proof goals or verification individually solve route drift.

claims.setting: 100 episodes each R2R-CE/RxR-CE; fixed monocular actions, three-backbone R2R analysis.

claims.text: Progress-aware compression improves efficiency while preserving useful navigation.
claims.setting: Off versus Goal on two backbones/two datasets, all agent token calls counted when complete.
claims.selection_vs_test: Within-episode memory, not retained cross-task optimization.
claims.result_denominator: Sol savings 35.94/56.59%; Astra 5.52/4.05%; corresponding SR decreases and Astra RxR SPL loss.
counterevidence: Incomplete usage excluded; compression can alter trajectories, hence local plots not aggregate savings; no generic truncation comparator.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Lower measured tokens with backbone-dependent success/path tradeoffs.

claims.setting: Go2, eight 15-20m routes ×3 trials, RGB only.
claims.baseline_control: Recorded baseline aggregates, not fully specified matched reruns.
claims.result_denominator: 83.3% and mean NE1.51m over24; no success threshold or routewise breakdown.
counterevidence: Editorial goal annotations; physical safety limit; no explicit endpoint criterion.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Counted physical trial performance reported, but transfer/general safety and verifier truth not established.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported matched-backbone simulation results support a framework-level gain, and measured compression trades token savings for small SR and sometimes substantial SPL losses; physical trials are reported but uncalibrated completion/safety and developmental independence limit broader claims.
unresolved: No internal-verifier truth audit or separate goal/verify causality.
Real success criterion absent; no confirmed construction-unused transfer.

G.reason: Clear route-progress/context residual grounded in navigation-agent and summary lineage; comparison to current workflow exists but many nearest originals not fixed.

M.reason: Paired completion conditions and completed/active history partition directly address drift and overhead with testable transitions; verifier remains fallible and cost tradeoff backbone-dependent.

X.reason: Appendix C specifies goal update, uncertainty routing, history replacement and STOP limitations; edited prompts and unaudited semantic verifier limit execution certainty.

measurement.reason: Benchmark evaluator provides simulation truth and physical 24-trial aggregate, but real successful-arrival criterion is unspecified; v2 success-criterion ceiling applies. No verifier confusion-matrix audit.

causality.reason: Same backbone/episodes/interface and Off→Goal support framework and memory comparisons; no goal-versus-verify toggle, budget equivalence only partial, memory changes path and SR.

holdout.reason: Two benchmark subsets and real routes without evaluator privilege; construction/development overlap and actual construction-unused transfer not documented.

statistics.reason: Three repeats per physical route stated; simulation repeats unspecified, no CI/paired tests or counted failure endpoint decomposition.

cost.reason: Comprehensive token accounting across agents incl compression/retries/cache and failed runs with usable usage; incomplete records excluded, no USD/wall-time/matched full internal budgets.
